final: WITH rt AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id), av AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS a FROM rt) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.total) AS combined_total, AVG(rt.total - av.a) AS avg_excess FROM rt, av WHERE rt.total > av.a GROUP BY rt.store_id
